blocks.text: Group 2 elements ki reactivity (react karne ki taqat) ko un ki electronic configuration se samjha ja sakta hai. In ke sab se bahar wale subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hote hain. Yeh do electrons kho kar yeh +2 charge wale stable ions (M²⁺) ban jate hain. Isi liye yeh doosre maddon (substances) se jaldi react karte hain. Be se Ba tak reactivity barhti hai, kyunke group mein neeche atom ka size barhta hai, shielding effect barhta hai aur ionization energy kam hoti hai. Is se electrons nikalna aasan ho jata hai aur reactivity barh jati hai.

blocks.alt: Group 2 ke paanch anasir (elements) Be, Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba: har aik laal aadhe gole (atom) ki shakal mein, jis ke neeche chhota neela aadha gola (us ka M2+ ion) hai. Beryllium se barium tak dono barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.1: Group 2 anasir ke atoms ke nisbati size (kitab ki Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen se daen: beryllium, magnesium, calcium, strontium aur barium. Har laal aadha gola pichhle se bara hai, aur us ke neeche ka neela aadha gola bhi.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal hissa atom hai aur neela hissa us ka M²⁺ ion. Ion atom se kaafi chhota hai, kyunke do bahar wale electrons nikalne se poora bahar wala shell khatam ho jata hai. Table 17.1 ke mutabiq atom: Be 112, Mg 160, Ca 197, Sr 215, Ba 222 pm; ion: 31, 65, 99, 113, 135 pm. Atom jitna bara, bahar ke electrons nucleus se utne door aur unhen nikalna utna aasan; is liye reactivity Be se Ba tak barhti hai.

Upar wali wajahon ki buniyad par reactivity series ko Be se Ba tak barhti tarteeb (increasing order) mein neeche di gayi shakal mein likha ja sakta hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke Be sab se kam reactive aur Ba Group 2 ka sab se zyada reactive element hai.

blocks.prompt: Mg, Ba aur Ca ko barhti reactivity ki tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: Mg < Ca < Ba. Group mein jo element jitna neeche hai, woh utna zyada reactive hai.

items: Group 2 metals do electrons de kar M²⁺ ions banate hain.
Neeche jate hue size aur shielding barhti, ionization energy kam hoti hai.
Reactivity series: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba.
